newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares open 3.73 pct up in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares open 3.73 pct up in Milan.

text.p: Shares in Italian information technology group Olivetti opened 3.73 percent higher at 589 lire on the Milan bourse on Wednesday.

Olivetti shares have lost around 28 percent in two days in market concern over the state of the company's finances and its future and on Tuesday it hit a record low of 555 lire before closing at 567.8.
Italian bourse watchdog Consob on Monday asked Olivetti to supply answers to seven questions on the state of its finances and its half-year results for 1996 published last week.
Consob said late on Tuesday it was expecting Olivetti's reply that day but a statement on what the answer contained was unlikely from either party.
Consob said it wanted to evaluate the information and to ask Olivetti management further questions in a meeting expected later this week.

Olivetti managing director Francesco Caio is due to meet Italian Industry Minister Pierluigi Bersani on Wednesday to discuss the crisis at the information technology group, which has not made a profit since 1990 and last week announced further half year losses for 1996.
